exposure: Infants with severe WMI and normal DMVs
Infants with severe white matter injury (WMI) and abnormal DMVs
outcome: Presence of white matter periventricular cysts
cohort: 2032 late preterm infants hospitalized between January 1st, 2009, and December 31st, 2018.
finding: Congestion/thrombosis of DMVs may be an important cause of severe WMI in late preterm infants, particularly periventricular leukomalacia-like WMI, and is associated with a higher likelihood of thalamic injury.
